text:
amira: Quick sync for 'DevLabs' micro-refapp launch next week. Plan: 3 short how-to tutorials, 1 tiny open-source refapp (README + docker), a 20-min mini webinar, social kit, and a single benchmark stat for hero. Owners?

tomas: I'll take the refapp + quickstart script. Want it runnable in <10 minutes. Will add a tiny CI to verify build.

elena: I can draft the tutorials (chat quickstart, embeddings search, cost-aware batching). Each ~600-900 words with code samples.

ben: I'll run the perf matrix and provide p50/p95 + cost-per-100k-token estimate. ETA EOD Thu. Command I'll run: `./bench_runner --model redwood-3b --batch 8 --seq 256 --out perf.csv`

design-bot: Reminder: create hero variants in FigJam by Mon. Link: https://figma.com/devlabs-assets

amira: Messaging seed: "Dev-ready refapps and tutorials to ship real LLM features faster." Keep it punchy and dev-first.

elena: Webinar format: 20-min demo (refapp walkthrough + perf highlights) + 10-min live Q&A. We'll preselect 3 dev questions.

tomas: Refapp README should include the benchmark in the header and a short 'why this matters' section. Ben, will need one clear stat for hero.

ben: Posting initial numbers: p50=72ms, p95=140ms on dedicated config. Cost estimate ~ $110 per 100k tokens (with batching). p95 delta vs hosted ~35ms. Use p95 delta for social card.

amira: Nice. For inbound lead routing: use utm_campaign=devlabs, utm_source=twitter, utm_medium=social and webhook to SFDC sandbox. Sam? (cc @ben for example payload)

bob: (not in participants) -- placeholder for ops

elena: Okay to reference caching + batching improvements in the tutorials? We'll show a short example of prefix caching effects.

ben: Yes. I'll add two tiny demo payloads: cache on vs cache off, and include the measured latencies. Example snippet: `{"prompt":"Explain X","cache":true}`

design-bot: Hero variants ready. Need the final stat from @ben to lock copy by Tue noon.

amira: Who will draft the X thread and the short launch post? I'll start drafts — dropping first pass Tue 9am.

tomas: I'll push initial refapp repo by Mon EOD and add a CONTRIBUTING.md.

elena: Tutorials draft target Tue EOD.

ben: Finalized numbers posted: p50=68ms, p95=132ms (dedicated); hosted p95=167ms; cost per 100k tokens: dedicated ~$108 vs hosted ~$152. Recommend social stat: 'Reduce p95 latency by ~35ms vs hosted.'

amira: Perfect. I'll write the launch post + X thread and share for review Wed morning. Thanks team! :rocket:
